result.rationale: The check is `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` — this tests whether e.origin is a substring of discourseUrl, not the other way around. A prefix origin like 'https://forum.example.co' is NOT contained in 'https://forum.example.com', so it would return -1 and be rejected. The described bypass mechanism (prefix origin passing the check) does not work with this indexOf direction; the finding misreads the substring semantics of the code shown in the diff.
